content.value: For a sprinkler system to work 6.9 bar of pressure is required. For a specific building the initial pressure in the pipe was kept 7.2 bar after the friction loss. The initial friction loss was 0.020 bar. After some years of use the pipe got clogged due to salinity, the clog reduced 2cm thickness of the pipe. If the thickness of the pipe is 1.5cm &the discharge of the water is 1.2m³/min. Find out whether the system will still work or not?

_source_title: B. Arch 3rd Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2022
